explanation: The COVID-19 pandemic delayed them by a year, but they kept the Tokyo 2020 name. The Games had been cancelled during both world wars, yet never postponed before.

claims.text: The Tokyo 2020 Summer Olympics were held from 23 July to 8 August 2021.
The Tokyo 2020 Olympics were not held in 2019, 2020 or 2022.
The Tokyo Olympics were postponed by one year because of the COVID-19 pandemic and kept the name Tokyo 2020.
The Summer Olympics of 1916, 1940 and 1944 were cancelled because of the two world wars, and Tokyo 2020 was the first modern Olympics to be postponed rather than cancelled.

claimResults.note: The 2020 Summer row gives an opening ceremony on 2021-07-23 and a closing ceremony on 2021-08-08, matching 23 July to 8 August 2021.
Both ceremonies of the 2020 Summer edition fall in 2021, so the Games were held in none of 2019, 2020 or 2022.

The edition kept its 2020 name (games '2020 Summer', year 2020) but ran in 2021, one year late. The COVID-19 cause rests on my knowledge (certain); the row's notes column says the same but is free text and not counted as evidence (manifest knownIssues).

That the cancellations were caused by the two world wars rests on my knowledge (certain).
The file gives the host and the actual dates (23 July to 8 August 2021) under the 2020 label. Only the host, year and date columns are used; the notes column is free text and not evidence.
Tokyo 2020 is the only Summer edition in the file with an opening ceremony between 2019 and 2022, and it is dated 2021, so the Games were not held in 2019, 2020 or 2022.

evidence.restatement: The IOC and the Japanese organisers agreed in March 2020 to postpone the Games by a year because of COVID-19, and the event kept the name Tokyo 2020 although it ran in 2021.
The Summer Games of 1916, 1940 and 1944 were cancelled because of the two world wars, and Tokyo 2020 was the first Olympics ever postponed rather than cancelled.

claimResults.note: Rival test for the trap option: 2020 is the label, not the year. The dataset lists 1916, 1940 and 1944 as editions without dates, but its notes column is free text, so this rests on knowledge.
